name: Mighty Moose Core
summary: Shared dependency library for Mighty Moose mods. Also comes with a set of useful commands!
description:
This dll provides version checking, config, persistence and systems along with a large set of data lookups and other shared functionality so that we don't have to have copies of the same code in all mods we release.

The core is open source on Github.

Installation

Unzip the archive into the server root directory (where the .exe is). This will place all the files in their place automatically.

Commands

Name Alias Parameters (* = Optional) Default Values Permissions RCON Description
Announce mann Message, MessageType*, Recipient* Notification, null Admin 🗸 Announces a message to everyone or a specified user.
Trades   SearchName   User X Displays available trades by player, tag, item or store.
Taste   UserNameOrId* Self User X Displays information about food preferences of the target user.
ReloadConfig   PluginName* MightyMooseCore Admin 🗸 Reloads the config of the supplied (non-singleton config) plugin.
Version       User 🗸 Displays the installed and latest available plugin version.
Documentation       User X Opens the documentation web page.
ListPlugins       User X Displays a list of all registered plugins.
ListConfigurablePlugins       User X Displays a list of all registered plugins that has a config.

Mighty Moose Mods

Mighty Moose mods are developed by the staff of the Mighty Moose server, here's a list of all the other mods we've made!

  • DiscordLink - Connects your Eco server to your Discord server for seamless cross posting of chat messages, live updated displays of the server status and many useful commands!
  • Chronicler - Automatically record game actions and query them using ingame commands - Stop griefers and abusers!
  • Price Calculator - An embedded price calculator on the server website - Calculate and update your buy and sell orders directly from the web!
  • No More Books - Change all book recipes to only create a configurable amount of scrolls.
  • AutoPause - Automatically pauses your server when it's empty and unpauses when someone joins.
  • AutoTP - Automatically teleport users to a location when they log in.
  • Safe DevTool - Moves the smite action on the DevTool to ALT + Right Click - Never accidentally smite anything again!

Donations

I develop and support the MightyMoose Mods in my spare time.

If you find them useful, I'd greatly appreciate a small donation :)
